messages:
sam_devex: sketch from design review: propose a 'tool chip' compact row in playground run history to group tool-calls by invocation and show a small schema diff + timings. quick take?

maria_design: love the grouping. can you drop an ascii mock so I can see spacing? also how do we handle really long tool ids?

sam_devex: ascii:
[Model output]
• [Structured] TranslateText v2  · 3 calls · avg 42ms · p95 120ms · schema changes (expand)
• [Unstructured] FetchUserProfile · 1 call · schema ok

noah_eng: grouping +1. engineering flag: if we collapse too many calls we lose per-call latency outliers. suggestion: show avg + p95 and allow expand to per-call list.

lee_prod: also need a clear fallback when schema validation fails: show an error badge and a one-click revert to the previous snapshot. preserve historical schema by default.

ashley_a11y: a11y items: chips must meet 2rem minimum tap target, provide keyboard focus ring, and include ARIA label like "tool invocation group: TranslateText, 3 calls". badges must meet 4.5:1 contrast. don't rely on color alone.

maria_design: microcopy tweak: replace "schema changes (expand)" with "schema changes" and show a chevron for expand. preserve expand state across paging. badges text: "Structured output" / "Unstructured".

sam_devex: thinking small inline badge to indicate structured vs free text for quick scanning, plus icon + short label.

lee_prod: UX question: when a tool schema changes, do we auto-rewrite old run entries? we should keep snapshots. maybe add a toggle "Apply current schema to past runs" that replays with current schema.

noah_eng: agree keep snapshots. implement a lazy reenact button that runs a simulated parse with current schema (opt-in). perf note: lazy-load diffs for >20 runs.

ashley_a11y: keyboard flow: Tab into run history, Arrow keys navigate chips, Enter expands diff panel, Esc closes. SR should announce "expanded schema diff, 3 changes". ensure icons have accessible names.

ci-bot: deploy-checks: add unit tests for run-history rendering with 0, 1, many tool-calls and very long tool ids. failing tests block rollout. :robot_face:

sam_devex: action items I captured: 1) tool-chip compact row with structured badge, name, counts, timing, diff affordance; 2) per-run schema snapshot + expand diff; 3) preserve expand state across paging; 4) keyboard + ARIA labels and contrast compliance; 5) revert + reenact affordances; 6) throttling UI for +N tools and lazy-load diffs for large runs; 7) CI tests for edge cases. reorder or add?

maria_design: reorder for visual priority: structured badge left, tool name, counts, timing, diff affordance. add tooltip copy: "Show schema used when this run executed".

lee_prod: add collapse for long tool lists into "+8 more" with expand. show summary line when collapsed.

noah_eng: implementation note: avoid rendering full diffs until user expands. stream diffs for big runs.

ashley_a11y: final: use icon + text for critical badges for colorblind users. focus targets and motion reduced for users who opt in.

sam_devex: thanks team. I'll update the prototype with these changes and post a PNG later. will ping when ready. :tada:
